item_name: Rothco Lightweight Reflective PT (Physical Training) Belt
item_short_desc: Stay visible and safe while working or training outdoors with Rothco's Lightweight Reflective PT Belt. Designed for optimal visibility in low-light conditions, this belt is constructed from durable, non-stretch PVC material that ensures long-lasting use. The high-visibility reflective strip makes it perfect for running, cycling, or other outdoor activities during early mornings or late evenings. With a 2-inch slide adjustable buckle, it provides a comfortable and customizable fit for any user.
description: Stay visible and safe while working or training outdoors with Rothco's Lightweight Reflective PT Belt. Designed for optimal visibility in low-light conditions, this belt is constructed from durable, non-stretch PVC material that ensures long-lasting use. The high-visibility reflective strip makes it perfect for running, cycling, or other outdoor activities during early mornings or late evenings. With a 2-inch slide adjustable buckle, it provides a comfortable and customizable fit for any user, while the quick-release buckle allows for easy on and off convenience. Measuring 45 inches in full length and 2 inches wide, Rothco's Reflective PT Belt is the ideal solution to enhance your safety while performing physical activities outside.
